text:
maya: Heads-up — the last two PMs flagged the same recurring pattern (db failover + long-tail cache stampede). I think we need a tighter postmortem follow-up flow: clear owners, fixed timelines, and an IC rotation cadence. Can we sync on a small ops playbook update?

jonathan: +1. can we land a timeline template? i.e. who owns 24h, 72h, 7d, and 30d actions. makes audits easier.

priya: Agree. Also we should tag action items with `owner:team` and `severity` so the tracker can filter by who actually needs to act. :white_check_mark:

lina: For comms cadence — propose: SEV2+ initial incident ping, 1h update, 4h update, incident close note. SEV1 add stakeholder bridge + exec summary by 6h.

ezra: Can we automate reminders into GH issues? e.g. create issue from template, assign owner, then bot pings if overdue. I can prototype.

maya: Love the automation idea. @ezra if you can prototype, let's pair on the templates. also we need an IC rotation suggestion — current list is ad-hoc.

jonathan: Rotation should be predictable. propose 2-week IC shifts, with a second-on-call shadow for handoff. shorter shifts mean more overlap. thoughts?

priya: 2-week seems fine. but add a quarterly review to rotate out people who are overloaded. also add a simple checklist for handoffs: 1) open incident board 2) context + ongoing mitigations 3) follow-ups assigned.

sophia: I can draft the timeline + checklist today. i'll include sample wording for external comms and a `followups.md` template with fields: owner, due_date, impact, mitigation, acceptance_criteria.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: create follow-up issues for incident 1799989920 — due in 72h.

lina: We should also track recurrence patterns monthly — add a "recurring incidents" column in the postmortem index and tag related PMs. This helps spot pattern clusters (backup jobs, cache invalidation, deploy-induced load).

maya: Great. action items: 1) @sophia — draft timeline + followups template (ETA EOD today). 2) @ezra — prototype GH-issue automation (ETA next Tue). 3) @priya + @lina — define comms cadence matrix and handoff checklist (ETA Thu). 4) @jonathan — propose IC rotation schedule and upkeep process (ETA Fri). I'll run a 30m working session tomorrow 10:30 PT to finalize.

jonathan: i'll bring a sample rotation calendar and a quick script to compute fair shifts.

priya: adding the working session to calendar now.

sophia: noted, will push a PR to `docs/incidents/playbook` with the templates and a short usage guide.

maya: thanks all. if anyone spots other recurring signals (metrics or logs) add them to the agenda before the sync. :sparkles:
